title: Inspect columns across entity and complex paths
goal: Inspect relational model metadata after upgrading EF and resolve entity, nested complex, table and view columns without assuming every property belongs to an entity.

selectionNotes: Use DeclaringType and distinguish IEntityType from IComplexType. Resolve columns with StoreObjectIdentifier for the selected table or view. EF11 complex paths may occur in key/index property lists; preserve list order and walk structural declaring paths. The older comparison retains an explicit entity SiteCode for key/index membership while separately inspecting its nested Location.Code. These are different authored models; this example does not migrate existing data. SQLite executes nested filtering and a keyless view. Native JSON indexes, container mappings and arbitrary provider hooks remain outside this route.
